title: Demand Response Programs Incentive Balance and Payout Conditions
content:
**Payout rule.** Earned incentives under the Demand Response Programs are paid under the program's payment method and payment timing once the balance reaches the program's payout minimum; smaller balances carry. Bill credits post to the enrolled service agreement and checks are mailed to the mailing address on the customer profile. The payout is the whole positive balance. A payout is made only while the enrollment is active or within the closing settlement after it ends.

**The incentive balance.** Each enrollment keeps one balance of incentives earned and not yet paid, in US dollars. It is raised by enrollment bonuses, event and seasonal incentives, monthly incentives, and by billing a negative balance to the service agreement; it is lowered by payouts, penalties and bonus clawbacks.

**Where the payment lands**

| Payment method | Destination |
|---|---|
| Bill credit | Posted to the enrolled service agreement as a demand response incentive credit on its account |
| Check | Mailed to the mailing address on the customer profile |

**Enrollment status and payout**

| Status of the enrollment | Payout |
|---|---|
| Active | May be paid |
| Unenrolled or removed | May be paid only within the closing settlement after the enrollment ends |
| Enrolled (not yet active) | Not paid |

The status is read from the company's enrollment record for that enrollment.

**Amount paid.** The whole positive balance at the time of payout — not a part of it. A balance below the payout minimum is not paid at that time and carries to the next payout.

**Illustrations (hypothetical balances)**

1. An active Peak Time Rebate enrollment holds $6.40 of earned rebates when its payout falls due. The balance reaches the $1.00 minimum, so the whole $6.40 is credited to the enrolled service agreement.
2. An active Home Battery Dispatch enrollment holds $18.00 after the season. The balance is below the $25.00 minimum, so it carries.
3. A Commercial Capacity Bidding Program enrollment ended at the close of a program month with $212.50 earned; the payout of $212.50 is made within the closing settlement after it ends.
